4fe39a8cbbc1092076fca1692441874050062c17.summary: This is a repository index page for indicator-of-compromise files on NSO Group's Pegasus spyware, from the Amnesty International Security Lab and partners, with the Pegasus Project as a collaborative investigation. It lists domain, email, file and process indicator files and a STIX file for use with the Mobile Verification Toolkit. It is an index of data files, not a threat report, so no facts are recorded.
